  \caption{\textbf{GSPA integrator over AllTheBacteria genomes.} The Stage D snapshot covers every genome of the $15$ wave-1 batches finished on 2026-10-19 (species representatives); run (a) covers the genomes that Stage C had already integrated, the first $20$ by sample identifier in each of $230$ batches. Both runs use \texttt{gspa-unified.jar} v2.1.0 with all six priors, three iterations, and Stage 2A relaxation, compared with Stage 0 noisy-OR on the same claims. A protein is rescued when it gains its first GO term with posterior $\ge 0.50$; a pair is suppressed when its posterior falls below $0.50$ or Stage 2A removes it. Rescues by prior count a protein under every prior with a positive entry for a rescued pair. Co-annotation conflicts include pairs that Stage 2A removed without a forbidden-table hit. Taxon-forbidden suppression requires the genome's taxid in the integrator's bundled NCBI hierarchy ($1{,}302$ taxa). The gap claims are KEGG-coverage gaps written by the batch pipeline. Runtime is the per-genome wall time of single-threaded JVM runs in Stage C; Stage D runs $96$ genomes per multi-threaded JVM. Sources: \texttt{results/allthebacteria/atb\_java\_summary\_stageD\_snapshot.json}, \texttt{atb\_java\_summary.json}, \texttt{insight3\_per\_genome\_java.tsv} (pipeline P11, \texttt{benchmark/allthebacteria/aggregate\_atb\_java.py}).}
